channel.title: The Wartime Report
channel.description: Open source, unbiased, independent daily coverage of the 2026 Iran War. Military updates, economic impact, investigations.

item.title: Day 27 — Israel Kills Hormuz Blockade Mastermind as Iran Rejects US Peace Plan
item.description: March 26, 2026: Day 27 coverage of the US-Israel-Iran war.

item.title: Day 26 — Iran Dismisses Trump's Peace Claims as Strikes Hit Tehran
item.description: March 25, 2026: Day 26 coverage of the US-Israel-Iran war.

item.title: Day 25 — US Sends 15-Point Peace Plan to Iran as Bushehr Nuclear Plant Hit
item.description: March 24, 2026: US sends 15-point peace plan via Pakistan, Bushehr nuclear plant struck, Trump declares 'we've won this war,' 1000+ more troops approved.

item.title: Day 24 — Trump Blinks: Ultimatum Extended 5 Days Amid 'Very Good' Iran Talks
item.description: March 23, 2026: Trump extends Hormuz ultimatum by 5 days, halts US strikes on Iran's energy sites, claims 'very good and productive conversations' with Iran. Iranian state TV declares 'US president backs down.' Tehran rocked by explosions. Iran fires missiles and drones at Bahrain. Brent at $112. Kremlin warns against nuclear plant strikes.

item.title: Day 23 — 48-Hour Ultimatum: Trump Threatens to Obliterate Iran's Power Grid
item.description: March 22, 2026: Trump issues 48-hour ultimatum — reopen Hormuz or US will 'obliterate' Iran's power plants. Iran strikes near Dimona nuclear facility. Israel's air defense fails to stop 2 missile strikes. Nuclear escalation fears mount.

item.title: Day 22 — Trump Hints at 'Winding Down' as Iran Strikes Diego Garcia
item.description: March 21, 2026: Iran fires ballistic missiles at Diego Garcia. Trump hints at 'winding down' but rules out ceasefire. Death toll reaches 1,444. Kuwait's Mina al-Ahmadi refinery hit. Saudi Arabia expels Iranian diplomats.

item.title: Day 21 — Three Weeks of War, No End in Sight
item.description: March 20, 2026: Iran warns of 'zero restraint.' Trump calls NATO allies 'cowards.' Switzerland halts US arms exports. Netanyahu signals possible ground invasion of Iran. Lebanon death toll tops 1,000.

item.title: Day 20 — Israel Strikes South Pars, Qatar LNG Crippled
item.description: March 19, 2026: Israel strikes South Pars gas field unilaterally. Qatar's Ras Laffan LNG facility hit — 17% of output cut for up to 5 years. Iran retaliates against Israeli oil refinery in Haifa.

item.title: Day 19 — War's Human Cost Hits Home
item.description: March 18, 2026: Three Palestinian women killed in beauty salon by Iranian missile shrapnel. Thai worker killed in Israel. The war's civilian toll spreads far beyond the battlefield.

item.title: Day 18 — Ali Larijani Killed, Israel Invades Lebanon
item.description: March 17, 2026: Ali Larijani, Iran's de facto leader after Khamenei's death, killed in strike. Israel launches limited ground invasion of Lebanon. Basij militia chief also killed.
